verdict.rationale: Browser Use ships an official open-source Python library (github, docs-19) and a cloud client SDK with documented usage patterns (client.runs.create, sessions, events polling) shown in docs-1/4/5/14, giving AI-native devs a concrete first-party SDK to build against. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Python (e.g. JS/TS), and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe-2 all 404) or independent third-party corroboration of SDK usage.
